step.name: Install node-pptx-templater
step.text: Install the package using your preferred package manager: npm install node-pptx-templater (or via pnpm, yarn, bun).

step.name: Load Template or Create Blank Presentation
step.text: Ingest an existing .pptx file, Buffer, or URL with PPTXTemplater.load() or initialize from scratch with PPTXTemplater.createBlank({ layout: '16x9' }).

step.name: Mutate Slides, Elements, Tables, and Charts
step.text: Inject text placeholders with AST run coalescing, format paginated tables, synchronize DrawingML charts with embedded Excel workbooks, and adjust element z-orders.

step.name: Export Across 8 Whitelisted Channels
step.text: Export cleanly using saveToFile(), toBuffer(), toStream(), toBase64(), toArrayBuffer(), toResponse(), toExpress(), or toFastify().

mainEntity.name: Does node-pptx-templater require Microsoft Office or LibreOffice?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. node-pptx-templater is written in 100% pure JavaScript and directly parses and serializes OpenXML (ISO/IEC 29500) ZIP packages in memory. It requires zero native binaries, C/C++ addons, LibreOffice, or Microsoft Office.

mainEntity.name: How does Chart Excel Dual-Sync prevent PowerPoint repair prompts?

acceptedAnswer.text: PowerPoint stores native charts in both DrawingML XML and an embedded Excel workbook (.xlsx). node-pptx-templater synchronizes both parts simultaneously in memory, eliminating repair warnings when opening slides in Microsoft PowerPoint.

mainEntity.name: Can node-pptx-templater run in AWS Lambda and Cloudflare Workers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. With a sub-15ms cold start and an in-memory Virtual File System (VFS), node-pptx-templater operates seamlessly on AWS Lambda, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, Bun, and Deno without writing to temporary disk files.

mainEntity.name: What is AST Run Fragment Healing?

acceptedAnswer.text: When template variables like {{COMPANY}} are typed or spell-checked in PowerPoint, Microsoft Office often fragments them across multiple XML run elements (<a:r>). node-pptx-templater automatically normalizes and coalesces these runs before performing substitution.

mainEntity.name: What are the 18 whitelisted I/O methods in v3.0.0-beta.1?

acceptedAnswer.text: The public I/O surface is locked to 7 static loaders (load, createBlank, preload, fromCache, clearCache, extractPptx, buildPptx), 8 export methods (saveToFile, toBuffer, toStream, toBase64, toArrayBuffer, toResponse, toExpress, toFastify), and 3 extraction methods (extractToZip, inspectVfs, getMediaList).

mainEntity.name: What are the 8 canonical categories in v3.0.0-beta.1?

acceptedAnswer.text: All API operations are organized into 8 canonical categories: Import/Export, Slides, Text & Placeholders, Tables, Charts, Shapes, Images & Media, and Elements.
